description:
The project is built against the Rust sysroot located at `/usr/local/rustup/toolchains/stable-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, with its source tree under `/usr/local/rustup/toolchains/stable-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/lib/rustlib/src/rust`. Within this workspace there are three crates: **utils**, **core**, and **macros**.

The **utils** crate (display name “utils”) has its root module at `utils/src/lib.rs`, uses the 2021 edition, and is version 0.1.0. It has no dependencies, is marked as a workspace member, and its source consists of the directory `utils/src` (no excluded directories). It is compiled with the `debug_assertions` configuration, targets `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, and defines a single environment variable `UTILS_ENV` set to “production”. It is not a procedural‑macro crate and its repository lives at `https://github.com/example/project-utils`.

The **core** crate (display name “core”) lives at `core/src/lib.rs`, also targets the 2021 edition, and is version 0.2.3. It depends on one crate – the crate at index 0 named **utils** – and is likewise a workspace member. Its source includes `core/src` with no exclusions, has an empty configuration list, targets the same triple, and contains no environment variables. Like utils, it is not a proc‑macro crate, and its source repository is `https://github.com/example/project-core`.

The **macros** crate (display name “macros”) is rooted at `macros/src/lib.rs`, uses the 2021 edition, and is version 0.1.0. It has no dependencies, is a workspace member, and its source comprises `macros/src` (no excluded directories). There are no extra cfg flags, it targets `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, and it defines no environment variables. This crate is a procedural‑macro crate; the compiled macro library can be found at `target/debug/libmacros.so`. Its repository URL is `https://github.com/example/project-macros`.
